what: MANAGER CONCERN, MEASURED: CONFIRM_WAIT_DAYS=60 forward-only cannot confirm ANY of the 13 m20 PASSes. Per-leg OOS trade rate (PASS OOS trades / days from split to PASS; corpus split + E5 measurement, 2026-10-16) gives 0.7-13.9 trades in 60 days against the rule's 25-OOS-trade floor; days to reach 25: ada 252, gdx 1067, gld 1225, iwm 2132, qqq 2104, scha 2252, slv 1017, splg 2076, spy 1243, eth_4h 260, eth_prop 108, sol_prop 179, xrp_4h 345. So at not_before (earliest 2026-11-28) every confirmation would fire, grade insufficient_base -> indeterminate (done, awaiting more_data) and the discovery stays unconfirmed with no automatic retry. BACKWARD-DISJOINT: not available inside the harness as built -- m20_fleet_exit_sweep.py has no start/lookback input and sweeps every bar the trainer holds, and the rule gates on IS AND OOS, so the PASS window is the whole held history (IS/OOS trade ratio 1.02-19.1 is history the PASS already used, not unseen history). SCOPE THE BUILD: (1) size the wait per leg from the measured rate (days to the rule's floor), not a constant; (2) a backward-disjoint confirmation needs the discovery itself to hold out an earliest span (template/harness change: a start-date input and a pre-registered holdout), else it does not exist; (3) until (1) lands, the 13 confirmation units should not fire at day 60 -- fix before 2026-11-28.
